name: DELight
full_name: Direct search Experiment for Light dark matter
summary: DELight uses superfluid helium-4 and magnetic microcalorimeters to explore light dark matter. German groups received DFG funding in 2026, and Canfranc records an intention for underground deployment.
detection_principle: Recoils in helium produce light and quasiparticles. Quasiparticles reaching the surface can evaporate helium atoms, whose small energies are measured by large-area microcalorimeters.

sites.site_status: Candidate underground site in a 2026 expression of interest

status.evidence: The 2026 institutional announcement and LSC expression of interest establish R&D and candidate deployment, not an operating underground dark-matter observatory.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
